Diagnosis: Added TestIssue4818_MethodNotAllowedLookupDoesNotPanic with the specified method-tree matrix; POST /b/clients/42 panics because gin.go reuses c.skippedNodes across method-tree getValue calls (routes_test.go:89-113; gin.go:744-781; tree.go:418-470).
Rejected hypothesis: The failure is not an ordinary unmatched-path 404 regression; the focused verifier reproduced a panic during method-not-allowed probing before a response was produced.
Verified invariant: The focused check reaches the reported defect with the exact route set and request, and the regression is confined to routes_test.go.
Untested invariant: After clearing the stack per lookup, unmatched paths must return 404 while matched alternate methods return 405 with the correct Allow header.
Unresolved gap: Determine the production fix location that preserves the pooled skipped-node backing allocation while resetting its logical length before each getValue lookup.
Graph question: Which context lifecycle and lookup call sites share c.skippedNodes, and where can its length be reset without changing normal route backtracking semantics?
Graph query: inspect_code_graph("skippedNodes ownership lifecycle and all getValue call sites")

+func TestIssue4818_MethodNotAllowedLookupDoesNotPanic(t *testing.T) {
+	router := New()
+	router.HandleMethodNotAllowed = true
+	handler := func(c *Context) {}
+
+	router.OPTIONS("/:p0/:p1/a/:p2", handler)
+	router.GET("/:p0/:p1/a/:p2", handler)
+	router.PATCH("/b/:p0/:p1/c", handler)
+	router.DELETE("/b/:p0/:p1/d/:p3", handler)
+	router.GET("/b/:p0/:p1/e/f", handler)
+	router.POST("/b/:p0/:p1/g/:p4/h", handler)
+	router.OPTIONS("/b/:p0/:p1/g/:p4/h", handler)
+	router.DELETE("/b/cache", handler)
+	router.GET("/b/clients/:p1/g", handler)
+	router.POST("/b/clients/:p1/g", handler)
+	router.PATCH("/b/clients/:p1/g/:p4", handler)
+	router.OPTIONS("/b/clients/:p1/g/:p4", handler)
+
+	var w *httptest.ResponseRecorder
+	assert.NotPanics(t, func() {
+		w = PerformRequest(router, http.MethodPost, "/b/clients/42")
+	})
+	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusNotFound, w.Code)
+}
